scope: Agent process proof, Codex quota telemetry, Windows GPU telemetry, and Ollama GPU-offload control.

codex_quota_probe.note: Snapshot observed during implementation; dashboard reads dynamically and does not hard-code these values.

gpu_control.label: GPU offload cap
gpu_control.semantics: Percentage of transformer blocks mapped to Ollama num_gpu; not a hard utilization percentage.

validation: Agent dashboard supervisor/API unit suite: 13 PASS before final handle cleanup
Codex app-server native RPC returned real rate-limit payload
Ollama derived model accepted PARAMETER num_gpu 15
Isolated dashboard GET /api/state returned Codex 92% remaining and Windows GPU telemetry
limitations: Antigravity CLI exposes no local quota percentage endpoint found during inspection; dashboard marks quota unavailable.
GPU offload percentage controls model-layer placement and does not guarantee Windows GPU utilization equals the slider value.
Codex exec sessions are separate one-shot processes and may not appear in another interactive Codex /agents view; dashboard proves them via OS process tree, session log, worktree and activity.
